title: Designing collective behaviour within a fixed coarse-grained description
summary: A fixed coarse-grained description need not uniquely determine the underlying microscopic rules. Variations in these rules can alter collective behaviour while leaving the retained observables unchanged. Here we develop a method to identify and use such variations for collective-state design. We construct families of microscopic models with exactly matched coarse observables and use the response derivative within each family to identify independent first-order output changes.
